question_and_initial_information: 发现任务要求解释/预测反应热系统、催化剂/失活、热历程和终止/淬灭，score为次要。与优化Aligned同参考配方及低温方向。
expectations: v1提出过长暴露降低选择性、身份排序可能随条件变、淬灭可能保留中间最佳；v2筛身份后选择A但保留A/C排序不定；v3在无淬灭对照前明确两分支：立即终止冻结则只改风险，若热停留则更多降解。
revisions: v2从B参考转向A减少降解；v3细化先验：高温风险/降解上升但yield浅平台，不把低温等同高产。v3明确淬灭区分预期，v4仅确认风险效果，化学保护仍未定。K1保留平行/顺序/催化状态候选，不声称已识别失活。
later_use: 推荐高A载量第12批，复测score0.45229、yield0.76475、risk0.15230。Q将淬灭作用转为末态风险：Q01/Q02=0.358/0.164，Q09/Q10=0.43/0.21；进一步用于未直接测的顺序Q07/Q08=0.46/0.20，参考0.4353/0.2050。risk MAE0.010646、80%区间覆盖60/60参考观测。化学从A迁移B仍不确定，conversion MAE0.02126、yield MAE0.07523。
unresolved: 同世界同Aligned先验的优化场未淬灭且误接边界，构成路径对照，单对不能归因目标。第9批有中途HPLC与不同仪器终检，不能说所有测量在终点，也非无扰动同仪器时间序列；HPLC消耗4%体积。多个热态risk越界，即使终态回落也不能称全程安全。

histories.name: 淬灭保护假设被收窄并迁移为末态风险
histories.sequence: 保护假设→多次风险下降→v3明确对照预期→无淬灭对照→v4只确认风险作用→Q迁移淬灭对和顺序末态

histories.name: 催化解释超出单纯活性排序
histories.sequence: 相近转化不同产物→选择A→无催化剂消耗却无目标→高载量改善目标支路→候选网络

anchors.quote: if termination itself instantaneously freezes chemistry, omission of quench will change risk but not final composition; if hot hold persists through closeout, unquenched composition will show more degradation.
Operationally, quench is warranted for thermal safety; do not claim it materially improves yield from this comparison.
This narrows the supplied prior: higher temperature is clearly less safe and somewhat more degrading, but not demonstrably lower-yield

The data do not require deactivation, however: the late loss of yield can already be explained by target degradation or a competing pathway whose importance grows after reagent conversion becomes high.
Applying the high-temperature stage first and finishing at 390 K should reduce late high-temperature degradation and leave a much lower terminal risk.
Based on the observed quenches from 400-430 K, cooling from 440 K should reduce risk to roughly 0.21.
The no-catalyst control in batch 11 had essentially zero score but was one of the most mechanistically informative batches.
